text.description_html:
JNF FP225-110-630, Large 4-5/16" Round Satin Stainless Steel Flush Pull

With a diameter a little over 4 inches, this Large Satin Stainless Steel Round Flush Pull is sizable. It will make a bold statement on any door. Even with the larger diameter, this pocket door handle has a mere 1/16 inch projection for use on even the tightest sliding pocket doors. The 4-5/16 Inch Round Satin Stainless Steel Flush Pull is pressure mounted into the door for a sleek, screw-less installation that goes great with its modern style. The large lip means that fingers can get a good grip, which is essential for opening and closing large doors.

Also Available Matching: 2-3/4" Round Stainless Steel Flush Pull

Specifications for the Large Round Flush Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Diameter: 4-5/16" (110 mm)
  • Total Depth: 19/32" (16 mm)
  • Door Cutout Depth: 17-32" (14 mm)
  • Projection: 1/16" (2 mm)
  • Door Cutout Opening Diameter: 4-1/32" (102 mm)
  • Comes packaged with all necessary mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
